stories.title: 标普考虑将 NVIDIA 信用评级下调至 AA-，关注治理与关键人风险

stories.sourceExcerpt: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.

stories.title: Amazon 据报与 Meta 谈判，拟允许 Muse AI 代理在其平台购物
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
stories.summary: Fortune 报道称，Amazon 已就允许 Meta 的 Muse AI 代理在其在线市场购物进行谈判，讨论聚焦 AI 推荐的商品类型和潜在条款。

stories.title: OpenAI 合并 ChatGPT 的 Chat 与 Work，重度用户可能更快触及用量上限
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
stories.summary: OpenAI 将在合并 Chat 和 Work 体验后引入统一用量计，重度用户可能更早遇到使用限制。
stories.analysis: 统一计量意味着 OpenAI 正把订阅从功能包转向算力配额，重度用户的成本会更加显性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

stories.title: 黄仁勋被指违反 NVIDIA 行为准则，员工可能不会忘记
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
stories.summary: TechCrunch 讨论黄仁勋违反 NVIDIA 行为准则一事，以及这可能对公司文化产生的后果。
stories.analysis: 高管行为与公司准则冲突会侵蚀内部信任，尤其在 NVIDIA 强调合规的关键时期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 称“向 AI 交出人类控制权”的指控荒谬
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
stories.summary: Amodei 反驳竞争对手称他主张把人类能动性交给 AI 的说法，尽管领先 AI 公司正在加速自动化自身研究和模型开发。
stories.analysis: 这场争论反映 AI 安全叙事与商业竞争已纠缠在一起，谁定义人类控制，谁就占据道德高地。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

stories.title: 纽约州禁售 AI 聊天机器人玩具五年，研究揭示不当内容和情感发育风险
stories.sourceTitle: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
stories.summary: 纽约州对 AI 聊天机器人玩具实施五年禁令，Common Sense Media 的新研究指出其存在接触不当内容和影响情感发展的安全失败。
stories.analysis: 儿童 AI 硬件将率先面对最严监管，安全设计和年龄验证不再是可选项。
stories.sourceExcerpt: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

stories.title: 多州总检察长反对 Character.AI 拍卖用户私聊，涉及 210 万未成年人账户

stories.analysis: 用户对话数据在破产程序中被视为资产，将迫使监管明确隐私数据能否被出售。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

stories.title: Vibe coding 工具冲击合成器行业：开源是否正成为新常态？

stories.title: Amazon 与 Meta 据报谈判解除对 AI 代理 Muse 的封锁

stories.analysis: 平台对 AI 代理的封禁若松动，说明电商巨头开始权衡代理流量与平台控制权。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

stories.title: NVIDIA 与黄仁勋仍需回答 Megaspeed 芯片去向问题

stories.sourceExcerpt: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.

stories.title: 黄仁勋据报向 NVIDIA 员工否认“特朗普让他复职”

stories.title: David Fincher 新片被质疑使用 AI，早期放映引发争议

stories.summary: Tidal 宣布 12 月 9 日禁止 AI 生成音乐，将删除约 2900 万首 AI 歌曲，并每天拒绝约 8 万至 8.5 万首曲目。

stories.title: Intentful 用 dots 代理 Aria 自动做网站调研和提案
stories.sourceTitle: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
stories.summary: Intentful 的 dot Aria 可研究网站、生成提案，并主动标记消息和解决问题。
stories.analysis: 垂直 AI 代理正从回答问题转向主动执行，价值在于替团队省下重复调研和跟进。

stories.title: OpenAI 举办企业法务 AI 对谈：连接业务上下文和可复用工作流

stories.analysis: 法务是 AI 落地的高价值场景，关键不是生成文本，而是把业务上下文变成可审计流程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

stories.analysis: 客服自动化已进入多模型分工阶段，工具调用和流程编排比单纯对话能力更决定效果。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

stories.title: Perplexity 谈如何用困惑度衡量 AI 模型进展
stories.sourceTitle: Perplexity and Intelligence

stories.analysis: 单一指标无法覆盖推理和工具使用，但困惑度仍是比较模型基础能力的低成本锚点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

stories.title: OpenAI 详解对抗性蒸馏防御：训练、防护、检测与执法多层组合
stories.sourceTitle: Combatting adversarial distillation

stories.analysis: 模型能力窃取已从论文问题变成产品风险，蒸馏攻防将成为模型厂商的常规安全预算。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
